title: PCG says Ayungin mission was for medical evacuation, not covert resupply
summary: The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) on Friday said its latest mission to Ayungin Shoal was solely for a medical evacuation and not a covert attempt to resupply the BRP Sierra Madre.
